title: Multi-Source Entity Fusion Workbench
noPlansHint: No existing plans in this session: fill in the form below to create one.
kindAreaLink: Area (pair link only, no geometry merge)
kindLineLink: Line (pair link only, no geometry merge)
policyRequireResolved: Require all reviews resolved before commit
noSession: No active session: the fusion workbench needs session context (authorization and source resolution are session-bound).
needRefsError: Fill in both source refs first
cardsHint: Fill in both sources, then inspect: row count / CRS / geometry / fields / temporal parse / license are disclosed per source.
licenseUndeclared: Not declared (must be completed via G18 at delivery)
previewHint: Preview gives a bounded projection of a real matching run: match stats, samples and warnings.
truncatedNote: Samples exceeded the preview bound: trimmed (explicitly disclosed, not silent)
budgetsNote: Budget caps: candidate pairs {pairs} · output features {features}
runHint: Run = idempotent durable job: after matching completes, continue to review/commit.
reviewTitle: Review queue ({total} items awaiting human adjudication)
reviewNotLoaded: Queue is empty or not loaded yet.
reviewNoItems: No pending review items: you can commit directly (per commit policy).
reviewStaleBanner: The review decision was updated by someone else (CAS conflict): refresh the queue to get the latest decision revision, then retry. This panel never overwrites another decision.
fieldValuePlaceholder: Manual values: field=value, comma separated (empty = keep rule)
invalidFieldValuesError: Manual field values must use field=value, comma separated
decisionsHint: Load to view all human decisions on this plan (decisions are locked: matching/refresh never silently overturn them; explicit unlock happens only here).
commitBlockedTitle: Commit blocked (commit_blocked): {count} unresolved review items remain.
commitBlockedHint: Finish the reviews above and commit, or switch the plan commit policy to allow-unresolved (unresolved items are output as single sources and disclosed).
qualityCounts: Quality summary: merged {merged} · withheld for review {withheld} · rejected pairs {rejected} · single A {singleA} · single B {singleB}
qualityTotals: {total} features · unresolved fields {unresolved} · decided pairs {decided} · orphan decisions {orphan}
resultsLoading: Loading result pages… ({size} rows per page, total is the full count)
refreshHint: A dry run first produces an impact report (added/removed/changed, decision triage); only after confirmation does the real refresh run.
impactSummary: Impact: added A {addedA} / B {addedB} · removed A {removedA} / B {removedB} · changed total {changed}
refreshApplyBtn: Confirm refresh (incremental rematch, creates a new run)
refreshUnsafeNote: Changed surface exceeds the safety cap: incremental rematch is unsafe (refresh_not_safe path) — use Run for a full recompute; locked decisions will be inherited by content key.
refreshUnchangedToast: Both source fingerprints match the base run: no refresh needed
refreshDoneToast: Refresh complete: a new run was created
